description: This source file defines the EntityModelReader class which models the <entity-model-reader> element in the entity configuration of the OFBiz framework. It handles parsing and representing this XML element and its resource child elements.

classes.name: EntityModelReader
classes.description: A class that models the <entity-model-reader> XML element, encapsulating its name and associated resource list.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the value of the name attribute of the entity-model-reader.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Returns the list of Resource objects representing <resource> child elements.
